title: Choose the visual world for Before Zero
question: The roll assigned the Departure Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Red and white is pinned; the first look is the whole incident.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: Station departure boards: rows ranked by time, a split-flap flip when something changes
options.thesis: Every household is a departure ranked by margin; the board flips the moment a route stops making it.
options.viewport: Red band with Before Zero and the incident clock; a lane strip with Act now, Watch, Unknown, Silent counts and free resources; the ranked board below with H17 selected and its source message, both routes and the Reserve button on the right.
options.risk: If the flip is overused it reads as novelty; it fires only when a lane or margin changes.

raised.raise: Each fact appears once: the lane is not repeated by colour, chip and text.
One type family on a strict size ladder from board digits to footnotes.
Bar length is exact minutes on one shared scale across every route.
Lane is shown by position and shape, never by colour alone.
Selecting a row pulls it forward and drops the rest of the board to faint.

options.label: Triage Tag
options.lineage: Field triage tags: white card, wire hole, tear-off priority strip
options.thesis: Every household wears a tag; the tear-off strip is its lane.
options.viewport: Four lane columns of household tags, H17 focused in Act now with its reply, margin and Reserve button.
options.risk: The obvious emergency metaphor; mass-casualty triage can read grim next to a real death.

options.label: Event Catalog Grid
options.lineage: Convention circle catalogs: numbered stamp-size cells packed edge to edge
options.thesis: All 200 households at once, one numbered cell each.
options.viewport: A 20-column grid of household cells with lane by fill pattern, H17 circled, its margin on the right.
options.case: Shows the whole incident better than any other card; loses on audience identification, coordinators do not know this form.
options.risk: Cells hide margins until selected; ranking is weaker than a list.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.case: Codes replace labels; a 2am coordinator cannot decode.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Pixel display type fights projector legibility.
options.kept: One family on a strict size ladder.

options.label: Dance Score
options.case: Upward time reads backwards for a dispatcher.
options.kept: Length equals exact duration on one scale.

options.label: Guide Map
options.case: Playful map conflicts with pinned red and white and with no real maps.
options.kept: State shown by position, not colour.

options.label: Data Field
options.case: Strobing black and white is hostile at 2am and drops the red.
options.kept: Selection pulls one row forward, the field goes faint.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An operations dashboard: side rail, KPI tiles, table, detail drawer, red accent.
canonCard.viewport: Rail on the left, five KPI tiles, the household table and an H17 drawer.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every ops tool; nothing a judge remembers.
